import sys

def run():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    t = int(next(it))
    a.sort()
    i = -1
    j = 0
    mx = 0
    while j < n:
        i += 1
        while j < n and a[j] - a[i] <= t:
            j += 1
        mx = max(mx, j - i)
    print(mx)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()
